name: Ruined tower
description: Stone tower stump: the upper part has fallen, hollow inside, rubble around its foot. Concept for review (#149): map decoration, random starting ruins, or what demolition (#130) or a battle leaves behind. No game mechanics yet.

variants.name: Low stump
variants.notes: Most of the tower is gone; knee-to-shoulder high walls and a ring of fallen stone.

variants.name: Broken tower
variants.notes: The back walls still stand high with a window slit; the front has fallen.

variants.name: Overgrown tower
variants.notes: An old ruin: moss and grass in the rubble.

variants.name: Tower in snow
variants.notes: The broken tower with snow on every top.
